title.vi: 1. Từ photo app đến nhiều product surfaces
title.en: 1. From a photo app to multiple product surfaces

paragraphs.vi: Bài này xây một photo/video social platform kiểu Instagram theo pressures: media volume, metadata placement, feed latency, ephemeral surfaces và geography. Các giai đoạn là teaching design có giả định rõ; không khẳng định đây là sơ đồ production hiện tại. Một stack quen thuộc vẫn có thể đi xa nếu access pattern, durability và ownership được thiết kế tốt.
paragraphs.en: This lesson builds an Instagram-style photo/video platform around media volume, metadata placement, feed latency, ephemeral surfaces and geography. Stages are teaching designs with explicit assumptions rather than a current production inventory. Familiar tools can scale when access patterns, durability and ownership are sound.

paragraphs.vi: Phạm vi có publish ảnh/video, follow/private audiences, feed, Stories, delete và retries. Ads, messaging và copyright enforcement là domains khác cần contracts riêng; mention chúng không đồng nghĩa thiết kế đầy đủ từng domain. Mọi bài toán sizing dưới đây là fixture để luyện reasoning.
paragraphs.en: Scope includes photo/video publishing, following/private audiences, feeds, Stories, deletion and retries. Advertising, messaging and copyright enforcement need separate contracts; naming them does not fully design them. Sizing below is illustrative reasoning.

title.vi: 2. State machine và ACK boundary trước service list
title.en: 2. State machines and ACK boundaries before service lists

paragraphs.vi: Upload session và published post không cùng lifecycle. Upload slot chỉ cho phép ghi một staging key; PROCESSING ACK nghĩa metadata/intent durable, không nghĩa post đã playable. READY chỉ sau validated authorized renditions; failed processing có visible pending/error contract. Retry cùng finalize ID trả cùng post/result, payload conflict bị reject.
paragraphs.en: Uploads and posts have distinct lifecycles. Slots permit staging writes; PROCESSING acknowledgements promise durable metadata/intent, not playability. READY requires validated authorized renditions, and failures have explicit pending/error behavior. Finalization retries preserve post/results and reject payload conflicts.

paragraphs.vi: Mọi downstream worker/index update giữ mutation/generation version. Tombstone chặn stale work sau delete; latest job completion không tự thắng latest business mutation. Caption edit, audience change và media replacement có thể cần versions khác: define field ownership/merge thay vì một integer tăng tùy tiện ở mọi service.
paragraphs.en: Workers and projections retain generation/mutation versions. Tombstones block stale work; the last job to finish does not override the latest business mutation. Captions, audiences and media may need distinct version domains with explicit ownership and merges.

title.vi: 3. 12 giai đoạn tiến hóa có exit criteria
title.en: 3. Twelve evolutionary stages with exit criteria

paragraphs.vi: Đọc từng giai đoạn theo problem → decision → cost → next pressure. Không tách thêm service chỉ để tăng số boxes. Trước thay đổi kiến trúc, nêu baseline p99/error/cost và failure behavior cần giữ; sau thay đổi cần drill ở boundary mới.
paragraphs.en: Read each stage as problem, decision, cost and next pressure. Additional boxes alone do not justify services. State baseline tails, errors, costs and required failure behavior, then drill new boundaries.

description.vi: Bắt đầu từ upload, profile, follow và chronological feed. Modular app dùng relational store cho metadata, object storage cho bytes, auth và indexed queries. Thử upload interrupted và lost finalize reply trước khi tách services; hai máy app cũng cần cùng source of truth cho session/upload state.
description.en: Start with uploads, profiles, follows and a chronological feed. A modular app uses relational metadata, object storage, authorization and indexed queries. Test interrupted uploads and lost finalize replies before splitting services; even two app nodes need shared upload/session authority.

title.vi: Stateless APIs và CDN cho bytes

description.vi: Tách control-plane authorization khỏi media delivery. API cấp upload slot giới hạn owner/key/size/expiry; client upload trực tiếp, finalize kiểm tồn tại/checksum/type/ownership. CDN cache immutable renditions; private content cần serving authorization chứ URL khó đoán chưa đủ.

title.vi: Logical shards và ID gắn routing

description.vi: Giữ tập logical buckets ổn định rồi map buckets tới physical hosts. Một ID có time/shard/sequence hỗ trợ routing nhưng không tự enforce ownership. Per-shard allocator phải xử lý burst overflow, clock rollback, restart và failover; writer epoch/fence ngăn hai owners tái sử dụng cùng sequence/time.
description.en: Keep logical buckets stable and map them to physical hosts. Time/shard/sequence IDs aid routing but do not enforce ownership. Allocation must handle bursts, clock rollback, restart and failover; ownership fencing prevents competing allocators.

problem.vi: Một database không đủ working set/write load; local autoincrements có thể trùng giữa databases.
problem.en: One database cannot hold the working set/load, and local autoincrements collide across databases.

decision.en: Use author-affine placement, epoch-aware shard directories and guarded allocation.

tradeoff.vi: Cross-author access cần projections/scatter-gather; hot author vẫn có giới hạn.
tradeoff.en: Cross-author reads need projections or scatter-gather; hot authors retain limits.

description.vi: Giữ cache cho active feeds/objects, đánh giá disk-based partitioned stores cho long inboxes/activity/events. Chọn partition/query/retention trước engine; Cassandra-style replication và consistency level không tự giải mọi concurrent update. Metadata quan hệ vẫn có thể ở SQL.

title.vi: Migrate mà không có hai write authorities

description.vi: Thiết lập network/identity và contract tương thích giữa môi trường cũ/mới. Backfill có version và CDC checkpoint, so shadow reads, catch up lag rồi activate new owner epoch. Rollback sau nhận writes ở target phải có reverse capture hoặc protocol rõ, không đơn giản đổi DNS về source cũ.
description.en: Establish networking, identity and compatible contracts across environments. Version backfills and change checkpoints, compare shadow reads, then activate new ownership. Once the target accepts writes, rollback needs reverse capture or an explicit protocol rather than just old DNS.

title.vi: 7. ID layout: time, shard và sequence
title.en: 7. ID layout: time, shard and sequence

paragraphs.vi: Với layout minh họa 41/13/10, id = (elapsed_ms << 23) | (logical_shard << 10) | sequence. 13 bits chứa tối đa8192 labels, không bắt buộc chọn đúng8192 logical buckets. 41 bits milliseconds khoảng69.7 năm, không41 năm. PostgreSQL bigint là signed: positive IDs trong layout đầy64bits này chỉ có40 positive time bits, khoảng34.8 năm; phải chọn sign/epoch/format migration rõ trước khi hết range.
paragraphs.en: In the illustrative 41/13/10 layout, shift elapsed milliseconds by 23, the logical shard by 10, then OR the sequence. Thirteen bits permit 8192 labels without requiring that bucket count. Forty-one milliseconds bits span about 69.7 years. Positive signed PostgreSQL bigint values permit only 40 time bits here, about 34.8 years; plan sign, epoch and format transitions.

paragraphs.vi: Sequence modulo1024 không tự ngăn duplicates: same timestamp/shard/sequence tạo cùng ID. Wait/reject sau capacity, monotonic clock strategy và exclusive allocator ownership là ba guards khác nhau. Uniqueness domain có thể là per-table; nếu media và comment dùng independent sequences cùng layout thì đừng tuyên bố global unique xuyên entity types.
paragraphs.en: Modulo 1024 alone does not prevent duplicates: equal timestamp/shard/sequence fields collide. Capacity waiting/rejection, clock handling and exclusive ownership are separate guards. Independent table sequences may define per-table rather than global cross-entity uniqueness.

paragraphs.vi: ID encode wall time không là trusted user timestamp, causality hoặc commit sequence. Cross-shard clock skew, long transaction và delayed writes làm larger ID chưa chắc later commit. UUIDv4 vẫn có thể paginate bằng composite created_at/id index; UUIDv7/ULID là options có time locality. Đánh đổi là index locality/width/routing và threat model, không tuyên bố mọi UUID sai.
paragraphs.en: Wall-time IDs do not establish trusted creation time, causality or commit order. Skew, transactions and delays break that inference. UUIDv4 can paginate through composite indexes; UUIDv7/ULID offer time locality. Evaluate width, locality, routing and threat models rather than declaring UUIDs universally wrong.

rows.vi: Đây là elapsed range từ custom epoch, không phải năm lịch của epoch.
rows.en: This is an elapsed range from the custom epoch, not the epoch’s calendar year.

rows.vi: Positive signed bigint với 23 low bits
rows.en: Positive signed bigint with 23 low bits

rows.vi: Time bit tiếp theo chạm sign bit; cần format/epoch migration trước giới hạn.
rows.en: The next time bit reaches the sign bit; migrate formats/epochs before the limit.

rows.vi: 76 requests phải chờ/reject hoặc dùng format mới; modulo không tạo thêm slots.
rows.en: 76 requests must wait/reject or use a new format; modulo creates no extra slots.

rows.vi: Giá trị nguyên sai 1 đơn vị dù timestamp/shard decode có thể trông hợp lý.
rows.en: The integer differs by one even when decoded time/shard still looks plausible.

caption.vi: Ví dụ ID dùng elapsed_ms=34359738369, shard=1341, sequence=1. Tính bằng integer/BigInt; không dùng Number để tạo giá trị gốc.
caption.en: The ID example uses elapsed_ms=34359738369, shard=1341 and sequence=1. Construct it with integer/BigInt arithmetic rather than Number.

caption.vi: Round-trip giữ nguyên ID qua JSON bằng decimal string. BigInt chỉ dùng ở nơi cần số học; không chuyển qua Number ở giữa.
caption.en: Preserve IDs through JSON as decimal strings. Use BigInt where arithmetic is needed, without an intermediate Number conversion.

paragraphs.vi: user_id % fixed_logical_count chọn bucket chỉ là một policy. Directory map bucket→host/epoch tách placement khỏi identity; scale hosts không đổi modulo denominator. Nhưng số logical buckets không “free”: catalog/schema count, connection pools, backup tasks và cross-shard queries có overhead. Hot creator có thể cần per-dataset subpartition; không thay user bucket tùy tiện vì ID routing đã public.
paragraphs.en: A fixed-bucket user modulo is one policy. Directories separate bucket identity from physical hosts/epochs, so host count changes do not change the modulo denominator. Buckets still cost schemas, pools, backups and cross-shard queries. Hot authors may need dataset-specific subdivision without silently changing public routing identities.

paragraphs.vi: Move protocol: choose target capacity; snapshot/backfill có version; capture/apply changes kể cả deletes; drain/catch up to barrier; activate target owner và fence source tại commit sink; publish directory epoch; redirect/retry stale routes bằng cùng request identity. Old source giữ read/rollback policy rõ; “change mapping” đơn thuần có thể split writes hoặc lose accepted changes.
paragraphs.en: Move by validating target capacity, backfilling versioned snapshots, replaying changes including deletions, catching up to a barrier, activating target ownership while fencing the source, then publishing the directory epoch. Stale requests retain identities. Mapping changes alone risk split writes or lost changes.

caption.vi: IDs ổn định không tự làm data migration atomic.
caption.en: Stable IDs do not make migration atomic.

detail.vi: Versioned snapshot + retained change capture.
detail.en: Versioned snapshots and retained change capture.

detail.vi: Rows, deletes, lag và actual invariants.
detail.en: Rows, deletions, lag and actual invariants.

detail.vi: Activate ownership epoch ở write authority.
detail.en: Activate ownership epochs at write authority.

detail.vi: Publish map; stale callers retry cùng identity.
detail.en: Publish maps; stale callers retry with stable identities.

paragraphs.vi: Hash/checksum chứng minh bytes tới đủ không chứng minh decode safe, nội dung được phép hay audience đúng. Isolate decoders, cap pixels/duration/expansion, reject decompression bombs và giữ malware/content checks theo policy. Job DAG ghi input generation và output keys; partial output không xuất hiện trong published manifest.
paragraphs.en: Integrity checks do not establish safe decoding, permitted content or correct audiences. Isolate decoders and bound pixels, duration and expansion. Retain policy checks and generation-bound job inputs/outputs; partial outputs never enter published manifests.

paragraphs.vi: Ready transition và feed intent cần coherent boundary như initial finalize. Một worker có thể thành công rồi mất reply; retry dùng conditional upsert/immutable keys. Delete đổi serving eligibility trước cleanup; stale ready job bị reject bằng current mutation/generation. Failed work có retry budget và DLQ/repair UI, không để PROCESSING vô hạn mà không cảnh báo.
paragraphs.en: Readiness and feed intent need a coherent boundary. Workers may finish and lose replies; retries use conditional updates and immutable keys. Deletion changes serving eligibility before cleanup and rejects stale readiness. Failed work needs bounded retries, repair queues and visible stuck-processing detection.

rows.vi: Có thể tạo outputs trong namespace của generation1; chưa public.
rows.en: May create generation1 outputs; they remain unpublished.

rows.vi: Serving bị chặn; purge tracking chạy riêng theo retention policy.
rows.en: Block serving; track purges separately under retention policy.

rows.vi: t2: worker v1 hoàn tất muộn
Conditional READY transition phải fail; dọn orphan outputs theo policy.
rows.en: Conditional readiness must fail; clean orphan outputs under policy.

rows.vi: Retry không được ghi READY đè tombstone; giữ evidence đủ replay horizon.
rows.en: Retries never overwrite tombstones with READY; retain evidence across replay horizons.

caption.vi: Readiness, media generation và deletion version là các contract được chọn rõ. Ví dụ dùng delete version2; production có thể tách field versions nhưng vẫn phải enforce điều kiện tại authority.
caption.en: Choose explicit readiness, media-generation and deletion-version contracts. This example uses delete version2; separate production version domains must still enforce the authority predicate.

title.vi: 10. Feed: push, pull, ranking và pagination
title.en: 10. Feeds: push, pull, ranking and pagination

paragraphs.vi: Với normal authors, push IDs giảm common read cost; high-fanout authors có bounded pull/merge hoặc separate channel. Threshold dựa post rate, active followers, read frequency và amplification chứ không một follower count vĩnh viễn. Cùng post có thể qua push/pull/retry nên dedup bằng post ID trước rank/hydrate. Follow/unfollow/private/block/delete cần current eligibility tại serving.
paragraphs.en: Push IDs for ordinary authors and use bounded pull/merge for high-fan-out authors. Choose thresholds using posting, active readership and amplification rather than a permanent follower count. Deduplicate posts across push, pull and retries, then enforce following, audience, blocks and deletion during serving.

paragraphs.vi: Ranking tối ưu nhiều outcomes dưới latency/diversity/safety constraints. Separate candidate recall, scorer calibration và final policy filtering. Stable session snapshot hoặc retained candidate order giúp pagination; nếu product chấp nhận feed refresh reorders thì expose semantics thay vì hứa no skip trên live mutable ranking. Feature outage có chronological fallback đã filtered, không fallback raw public object IDs.
paragraphs.en: Ranking optimizes multiple outcomes within latency, diversity and safety constraints. Distinguish recall, calibration and policy filtering. Retained ordering/snapshots stabilize pages; otherwise declare refresh/reordering semantics. Feature failures may use an authorized chronological fallback, never unfiltered object IDs.

title.vi: 11. Stories: eligibility, archive và seen holes
title.en: 11. Stories: eligibility, archives and viewed-state holes

paragraphs.vi: expires_at là product rule kiểm bằng server time; cache TTL/lazy cleanup có thể trễ. Trước URL/capability, check now < expires_at, audience và tombstone; long-lived signed URLs/cache phải phù hợp expiry/revocation window. Archive/highlights là retained authorized view riêng, không biến deleted/expired item thành active story. “Disappears from tray” khác physical erasure.
paragraphs.en: Server-time expiry is a product predicate even when cache cleanup lags. Before issuing capabilities, validate expiry, audience and tombstones; URL/cache lifetimes must honor serving windows. Archives/highlights are separate authorized views, and disappearing from trays is not proof of erasure.

paragraphs.vi: Seen state exact cần account/device merge: max sequence chỉ đúng nếu tất cả items trước marker đã xem hoặc product cho approximate. Jump tới story102 khi101 chưa xem tạo hole. Giữ sparse set/bitmap hoặc contiguous watermark+holes với bounded retention; multi-device union của observed identities không tự làm mọi lower sequence observed. Edit/delete và new story arrival cần stable IDs/generations.
paragraphs.en: Exact cross-device viewed state cannot generally use only a maximum sequence: viewing 102 before 101 leaves a hole. Use sparse sets, bitmaps or contiguous watermarks with holes and bounded retention. Union observed identities across devices without assuming lower sequences were viewed; preserve identities across edits, deletion and arrivals.

title.vi: 12. Runtime, geography và recovery có scope khác nhau
title.en: 12. Runtime, geography and recovery have distinct scopes

paragraphs.vi: Pre-fork sharing có thể giảm memory nhưng GC/refcount writes tạo copy-on-write. Profile private/shared RSS, allocations và long-lived cycles trước thay runtime knobs. Disable cyclic GC không tắt refcounts hoặc làm mọi object immutable; có leak/recycling trade-off. Immortal-object work là hướng khác để giảm runtime metadata writes, không lý do copy một production flag vào mọi Python app.
paragraphs.en: Pre-fork sharing can reduce memory while GC/reference metadata writes trigger copy-on-write. Profile memory, allocations and cycles before tuning. Disabling cycle collection neither disables reference counts nor makes all objects immutable. Immortal objects offer another mechanism, not a reason to copy a flag into every Python app.

paragraphs.vi: Home-region writes giảm network coordination khi authority/replication locality đúng. Global follows/privacy metadata có thể cần cross-region reads hoặc replicated versions; eventual projections không được tự grant quyền. Failover nêu RPO/RTO theo metadata/media/events riêng, surviving capacity, replay effects và owner fencing. Client travel khác home-data migration; proximity routing không tự quyết data residency.
paragraphs.en: Home-region writes reduce coordination only when authority and replication are local. Global relationships/privacy still need appropriate reads or versions, and eventual projections never grant permission. Define separate recovery contracts for metadata, media and events with capacity, replay and fencing. Travel differs from data migration; proximity is not residency policy.

title.vi: 13. Reels: media pipeline và feedback loop
title.en: 13. Reels: media pipelines and feedback loops

paragraphs.vi: Video làm ingest/encode/egress cost tăng theo duration và watch distribution. Build basic playable ladder sau validation, rồi schedule advanced encodes khi expected saved bytes × future views đáng compute/storage cost. Benefit model cần codec/device support, quality metric và prediction uncertainty; viral videos có preemption/priority nhưng phải chống starvation cho new uploads.
paragraphs.en: Video costs depend on duration and viewing distribution. Produce basic playable ladders after validation, then schedule advanced encodes when expected delivery savings justify compute/storage. Account for codecs, devices, quality and forecast uncertainty. Viral priorities need protections against starving new uploads.

paragraphs.vi: Adaptive bitrate là player feedback loop theo measured throughput/buffer; recommendation là content-selection loop theo user/model features. Chúng tương tác qua QoE và observed watch time nhưng không cùng controller. Instrument startup, rebuffer, skip, completion và CPU/battery; experiment phải tránh future leakage và optimize narrow metric gây harmful feedback.
paragraphs.en: ABR controls playback using throughput/buffers; recommendation selects content using user/model features. They interact through QoE and viewing observations but are distinct controllers. Measure startup, stalls, skipping, completion and device costs while avoiding leakage and harmful single-metric feedback.

title.vi: Một phép tính benefit trước khi xếp queue

items.vi: Giả định clip 30 s, rendition mới tiết kiệm 0.5 Mbps ở cùng quality target và device tương thích: mỗi lượt phát đủ clip tiết kiệm 30 × 0.5 / 8 = 1.875 MB decimal.
items.en: Assume a 30 s clip and a 0.5 Mbps reduction at the same quality target on compatible devices: each full playback saves 30 × 0.5 / 8 = 1.875 MB decimal.

items.vi: 100 future plays → 187.5 MB; 100,000 plays → 187.5 GB. Cùng một encode cost có benefit khác rất lớn theo future watch distribution.
items.en: 100 future plays save 187.5 MB; 100,000 save 187.5 GB. The same encoding cost can yield very different benefits under future viewing distributions.

title.vi: Chỉ là forecast, chưa phải savings chắc chắn
title.en: A forecast is not guaranteed savings

items.vi: Partial plays, cache behavior, existing downloads, forecast error, new-rendition storage và codec/device coverage đổi lợi ích thực. So quality bằng measured metric, không giả mọi codec cùng chất lượng.
items.en: Partial plays, caches, prior downloads, forecast error, rendition storage and codec/device coverage change actual benefits. Measure quality rather than assuming codec equivalence.

items.vi: Giữ basic ladder ready, dành quota cho new uploads và đo actual saved bytes/QoE sau rollout. Popularity queue không được starve mọi video mới.
items.en: Keep basic ladders ready, reserve capacity for new uploads and measure realized bytes/QoE after rollout. Popularity priorities must not starve new videos.

title.vi: 14. Failure matrix và bằng chứng cần có

paragraphs.vi: Đo upload-finalize latency, processing age, ready-to-feed lag, missing/forbidden media, duplicate posts, deleted resurrection và p99 theo cohorts. Logs nối upload/post/generation/request/event IDs nhưng hạn chế sensitive media URLs và personal content. Mỗi metric cần action/owner, không chỉ dashboard.
paragraphs.en: Measure finalization, processing age, feed lag, missing/forbidden media, duplicates, resurrection and cohort tails. Correlate upload, post, generation, request and event identities without leaking sensitive URLs/content. Metrics need actions and owners.

rows.vi: Durable intent eventual repair có bound/alert.
rows.en: Durable intent supports bounded monitored repair.

rows.vi: Tombstone/generation không bị READY ghi đè.
Sink rejects stale epoch; sequence state không đủ.
rows.en: Sinks reject stale epochs; sequences alone are insufficient.

rows.vi: Partition old host rồi activate new.
Server eligibility reject dù bytes/entry còn tồn tại.
rows.en: Reject expired serving despite retained bytes/entries.

rows.vi: Delay cleanup, cached URL và replica lag.
View102 trên phone,101 unseen trên tablet.
rows.en: View 102 on a phone while 101 remains unseen.

rows.vi: Explicit RPO, fenced authority, bounded degradation.
rows.en: Explicit RPO, fencing and bounded degradation.

rows.vi: Lagged replica promotion + stale routing + saturated backup.
rows.en: Lagged promotion, stale routes and backup saturation.

title.vi: 15. Luyện end-to-end và phản biện assumptions

paragraphs.vi: Bắt đầu với một upload và một feed read, rồi chọn deep dive theo bottleneck. Dưới đây là worked answers cho design reasoning, không một kiến trúc duy nhất bắt buộc. Nói rõ authority, lost reply và deleted-data behavior trước khi thêm cache/database mới.
paragraphs.en: Trace one upload and feed read, then choose bottleneck-driven deep dives. These worked answers support reasoning rather than mandate one architecture. Explain authority, lost replies and deletion before adding stores.

question.vi: Vì sao uploadURL thành công vẫn chưa được public post?
question.en: Why does a successful upload URL not imply a public post?

answer.vi: Bytes có thể thiếu validation/safety/derivatives; finalize phải verify ownership/generation rồi commit PROCESSING/result/intent. READY sau checked outputs và current audience. Object exists không là authorization hay readiness.
answer.en: Bytes may lack validation, safety checks or renditions. Finalization verifies ownership/generation and commits processing/result/intent; readiness follows checked outputs and current audiences. Existence establishes neither authorization nor readiness.

question.vi: Modulo sequence có bảo đảm unique không?
question.en: Does a modulo sequence guarantee uniqueness?

answer.vi: Không. Same ms/shard lặp1024slots là collision; clock rollback/restart và two owners thêm failure modes. Need capacity wait/reject, retained monotonic state/exclusive ownership, fencing và string serialization. ID namespace per-table hay global phải rõ.
answer.en: No. Reusing 1024 slots in one shard/millisecond collides; clock rollback, restarts and competing owners add failures. Bound capacity, preserve state/ownership, fence writers and serialize exactly. Define per-table versus global namespaces.

question.vi: 41-bit timestamp có 41 năm và positive bigint luôn đủ không?
question.en: Does a 41-bit timestamp mean 41 years and always fit positive bigint?

answer.vi: Không:2⁴¹milliseconds khoảng69.7years. Với23lowbits, positive signed64bit chỉ chứa40timebits≈34.8years. Chọn epoch/sign/storage/order và migration policy. JS Number còn chỉ exact tới2⁵³−1, nên truyền decimal string/BigInt boundary.
answer.en: No. Two to the41 milliseconds spans about 69.7 years. With 23 low bits, positive signed 64-bit leaves40 time bits, about 34.8 years. Plan epoch, sign, order and migration; JavaScript integers require exact transport beyond the safe limit.

question.vi: Thêm hosts có cần đổi user modulo không?
question.en: Does adding hosts require changing user modulo?

answer.vi: Không nếu fixed logical buckets. Đổi mapping sau copy/CDC/verify/fence/cutover; chỉ sửa mapping không đủ. Hot author/data pattern có thể yêu cầu thiết kế subpartition có migration riêng.
answer.en: Not with fixed logical buckets. Change placement after copying, capture, verification, fencing and cutover; editing the map alone is insufficient. Hot datasets may need separately migrated subpartitions.

question.vi: Story TTL24h có chứng minh không ai xem sau24h?
question.en: Does a 24-hour TTL prove nobody can view after 24 hours?

answer.vi: Không. Cache cleanup có thể trễ, replica/URL/CDN còn serve. Check expires_at/current ACL ở serving và align capability lifetime. Archive/backup retention khác active eligibility; không hứa xóa screenshot người dùng đã lưu.
answer.en: No. Cleanup may lag and replicas, URLs or CDNs may still serve. Validate expiry/permissions and align capability lifetimes. Archives/backups differ from active eligibility, and saved screenshots cannot be revoked.

question.vi: Có thể dùng max viewed ID cho Stories không?
question.en: Can Stories use a maximum viewed ID?

answer.vi: Có nếu contract là contiguous consumed prefix hoặc approximate được chấp nhận. Out-of-order view102 bỏ101 làm max-only đánh dấu nhầm. Giữ holes/bitmap/set và define multi-device merge/retention.
answer.en: Only for contiguous consumed prefixes or explicitly approximate behavior. Viewing 102 before 101 makes a maximum falsely mark 101. Retain holes/sets/bitmaps and define cross-device merging and retention.

question.vi: UUIDv4 không paginate được đúng không?

answer.vi: Vẫn paginate bằng created_at+id composite stable index/cursor. Random IDs có locality/width trade-off, không mất capability pagination. UUIDv7/ULID/time-shard layout có properties khác và clock/security considerations.
answer.en: Composite creation-time/ID indexes and cursors still paginate UUIDv4. Random keys have locality/width costs, not an inability to paginate. Time-based alternatives have different properties and clock/security considerations.

question.vi: Advanced encode nên chạy cho mọi video?
question.en: Should every video receive expensive encoding?

answer.vi: Không mặc định. So expected future byte/QoE benefit với compute/storage/device support và uncertainty; basic ladder phải ready sớm. Re-evaluate viral cohorts, fairness/starvation và actual quality thay giả equal-quality saving.
answer.en: Not by default. Compare future delivery/QoE benefits with compute, storage, device support and uncertainty while making basic ladders ready early. Reevaluate viral cohorts, starvation and measured quality rather than assuming equal-quality savings.
